title: One-tape action decoding
statement: For every natural number $n$, every action $a$ of a one-work-tape binary machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and every bit string $x$, reading the serialization of $a$ followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $a$ together with $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action with one work tape, binary symbols, and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
